## Summary

I successfully resolved ticket T-6001. The search-api deployment stopped scaling after the 4.8.0 release because the new `log-forwarder` sidecar container (fluent-bit) was added without CPU resource requests. Kubernetes HPA requires all containers to have CPU requests defined to calculate pod-level CPU utilization; when any container lacks requests, the HPA shows "cpu <unknown>" and cannot scale.

The fix is to add CPU and memory requests to the log-forwarder container in the Deployment specification. Once applied, the HPA will resume scaling to handle peak lunchtime load.
